from hinoki.cache import Cache, CacheModule, MemoryCache, DatabaseCache. The cache guide explains backends, TTLs and migrations.

Base resource API with async methods and explicit sync counterparts.

namespace ¶

A view whose keys are prefixed with name; it shares this backend, so the backend's worker binding and cleanup still apply to it.

set_schema async ¶

set_schema(
    key: str, value: S, *, ttl: float | timedelta
) -> None

Store the declared fields of value; computed values are left out so get_schema validates them back. A schema with a Secret field is refused: the cache would only ever hold its mask.
